DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM information_schema.columns
        WHERE table_schema = 'public'
          AND table_name = 'student_pet_project_milestone'
          AND column_name = 'pet_project_milestone_id'
    ) AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM information_schema.columns
        WHERE table_schema = 'public'
          AND table_name = 'student_pet_project_milestone'
          AND column_name = 'pet_project_part_milestone_id'
    ) THEN
        ALTER TABLE student_pet_project_milestone
            RENAME COLUMN pet_project_milestone_id TO pet_project_part_milestone_id;
    END IF;
END $$;
